landing.title: Tathmini Afya
landing.subtitle: Imarisha Afya | Improve Health
landing.description: Tathmini Afya is a modern digital platform designed to help individuals monitor their health, evaluate risk factors, track vital sign trends, and receive timely alerts, guidance, and practical tips for preventing and managing chronic diseases.
landing.tryNowHint: Try without an account — your data won't be saved.
landing.feature3Desc: Your data stays safe and confidential
landing.dataAnalyticsDesc: Get health insights with data-driven analytics
landing.modernTechDesc: Get health recommendations tailored to you based on your data quickly and accurately, so you can take action early and take better care of yourself.
landing.ctaDesc: Be part of a community that uses this platform to stay on top of their health and access care easily whenever they need it.
landing.card1Desc: log key measurements like sugar, blood pressure, and weight.
landing.card1Detail2: see your current status after every entry.
landing.card1Detail3: get instant feedback: normal, elevated, or high.
landing.card2Desc: screen your risk for diseases like diabetes, heart, cancer, and mental health.
landing.card2Detail2: heart disease and cancer lifestyle indicators.
landing.card3Desc: improve exercise, nutrition, sleep, and hydration for better health.
landing.card3Detail3: daily habits scoring and progress reports.

doctorPrep.heading: JITAYARISHE KUONANA NA DAKTARI
doctorPrep.desc: Question Builder app will help you prepare before doctor visits, ask better questions, and get screening suggestions based on your age and gender.

disclaimer.heading: Disclaimer
disclaimer.p1: The Afya Assessment platform is not a substitute for professional medical care or a doctor's advice.
disclaimer.p2: It is designed to help you track and manage your health, and build a habit of regular health assessments.
disclaimer.p3: Through insights and analytics, you can identify health risks early and take appropriate action, including seeking hospital care in time.
disclaimer.p4: This information also helps your doctor understand your condition more easily and improve treatment outcomes.

nutrition.fruitsVeg: Add more fruits and vegetables — aim for 5 servings a day.
nutrition.lessSugar: Reduce sugary drinks. Replace with water.
nutrition.lessFastFood: Cut fast food in half this coming week.
nutrition.wholeGrains: Swap white rice for brown rice or millet.

exercise.strength: Add strength training (push-ups, squats) at least 2 days/week.

sleep.duration: Sleep 7-9 hours per night for best health.
sleep.latency: Avoid screens 1 hour before bed. Try reading.

hydration.thirstFreq: Don't wait for thirst — drink before feeling thirsty.

stress.talk: Talk to a friend or family about how you feel.

gad7.support: Talk to a friend or professional about your worries.
gad7.professional: Seek help from a mental health professional.

findrisc.keepUp: Your risk is low — keep it up!

heart.quitSmoking: Quit smoking — it's the most important step.
heart.bp: Manage blood pressure — reduce salt and exercise.
heart.chol: Test cholesterol and follow your doctor's advice.

vital.trendsDesc: Weekly or monthly averages of your vital signs.

bp.normal: Your blood pressure looks healthy. Keep up the good diet and exercise.
bp.elevated: Your blood pressure is slightly elevated. Cut back on salt and rest well.
bp.high: Your blood pressure is elevated, reduce salt intake and monitor regularly.
bp.low: Your blood pressure is low. Drink water, eat a small snack, and re-check.

hr.normal: Your heart rate is in the normal range.
hr.high: Your heart rate is high. Rest for 10 minutes and re-check.
hr.low: Your heart rate is low. If you feel dizzy, contact your doctor.

temp.elevated: Your temperature is slightly elevated. Drink water and rest.
temp.high: You have a fever. Rest, drink fluids, and see a doctor if it continues.
temp.low: Your temperature is low. Warm up and re-check.

bmi.normal: Your weight is within a healthy range.
bmi.overweight: Your weight is slightly high. Add more activity and cut fatty foods.
bmi.obese: Your weight is well above healthy range. Talk to a nutritionist and exercise regularly.
bmi.underweight: Your weight is below healthy range. Add more protein and whole grains.

sugar.normal: Your blood sugar is in the normal range.
sugar.elevated: Your sugar is starting to climb. Cut sugary drinks and add vegetables.
sugar.high: Your blood sugar is high. Re-check in an hour and contact your doctor.
sugar.low: Your blood sugar is very low. Eat something sweet (juice or fruit) right away.
